kite.comment: Direct HTTP gets a Cloudflare 403, so the mcp-remote bridge is required. mcp-remote needs Node >= 20.18.1 (see .nvmrc), so make sure `npx` resolves to a recent Node.

wallet.comment: Plain streamable HTTP with the access token from the Wallet app (Settings, MCP). Paste the WHOLE token: export WALLET_MCP_TOKEN=<token> in the terminal, then start `claude` from this folder. A truncated token is rejected with HTTP 401.

indmoney.comment: Returns 401 with OAuth 2.1 + PKCE discovery metadata; Claude Code handles the flow natively.

groww.comment: Groww's official hosted MCP server (stocks and F&O only; mutual funds are not supported yet), through the bridge Groww documents. Its sign-in only accepts the bridge's callback on port 52155 (http://localhost:52155/oauth/callback); Claude Code's native OAuth sends a random port and /callback, which Groww rejects. Needs Node >= 20.18.1, and port 52155 free. IT EXPOSES ORDER TOOLS and their names are not published: fingod only ever calls read tools. After connecting, list the tools and deny the order ones in .claude/settings.json (see docs/ONBOARDING.md).

coinbase.comment: Coinbase's official hosted server, OAuth (sign in with /mcp). IT CAN TRADE, TRANSFER AND CONVERT: fingod only reads (balance, portfolios, prices), and the write tools are denied in .claude/settings.json by the names Coinbase documents. When signing in, give it access to as little as Coinbase lets you.

binance.comment: Binance has no official MCP server; this is a community one (PyPI amazing-binance-mcp, Apache-2.0), run with uv. It reads BINANCE_API_KEY plus BINANCE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH (or BINANCE_API_SECRET) from the environment: export them before starting claude, never write them into a file. Create the key with ONLY 'Enable Reading' ticked, so it cannot trade whatever the server does. Trading stays off unless BINANCE_ALLOW_TRADING=1, which fingod never sets, and the order tools are denied in .claude/settings.json too.
